scope: Per-workgroup exclusive prefix scan and block totals
tolerance_reason: All prefix values, uniforms and guard words compare exactly as u32.
preconditions: Batched contiguous non-overflowing u32 counts with recorded strides and hierarchy
Distinct physical buffers, sufficient initialized storage and ordered dispatch completion
Bounded signed address intermediates; empty batches execute an explicit no-op
invariants: Rust 256-lane tree and partial-block zero padding preserved
Full scan agrees with independent exclusive prefix sums in every batch
Unused scratch and guard words remain unchanged
